Heyheyhey, enjoyed! I'd click "Like" on the metaphor and share if we was on Fb though it's like 90 degrees here and imagining ice is torture. And are ya gonna post that definition of rhetoric to #definerhetoric? I hope so!

And I was wondering what you think about the slipperiness of defining rhetoric.  You know, isn't it cool how a Zamboni can clean a surface and offer a different perspective-one where we ain't skatin' on persuasion but maybe we're skatin' on communication or art or discourse. How do ya think that might be considered a strength of our profession?
